text: dsh-memory（DSH 插件，适用于 DSH 客户端）：为 agent 提供跨会话持久记忆与笔记工具。它通过 Cordis 插件入口接入 DSH 的 storageDomain，并注册 memory_set、memory_get、memory_delete 和 memory_search 工具。用户可按稳定 key 保存事实并附加标签，按 key 读取或列出记录，删除条目，也可对 key、内容和标签做不区分大小写的子串搜索并按标签筛选。记录由部署方配置的存储后端持久化，重启后仍可取回。适合希望在不同会话间保留项目约定、事实和工作笔记的 DSH 用户；代码没有配置外部 API 密钥。

dsh-memory is a DSH plugin for persistent notes across sessions. It connects to DSH storageDomain and provides tools to save by key, read or list entries, delete them, and search keys, values, and tags with optional tag filters. Records use the deployment-configured backend after restarts.
想让 DSH 在不同会话之间记住项目约定和重要事实。
有没有办法把笔记按 key 存起来，之后再查出来？
I want my DSH agent to keep searchable notes between sessions.
dsh-memory 的功能「持久化记忆条目」：agent 可调用 memory_set，以稳定 key 保存事实或笔记并附加可选标签；相同 key 会更新已有内容，记录写入 DSH storageDomain。
dsh-memory 的功能「读取与搜索记忆」：agent 可按 key 读取单条或列出全部记录，也可用 memory_search 对 key、内容和标签做不区分大小写的子串匹配，并要求结果包含指定标签。
dsh-memory 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 90 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-memory README · dsh-memory：[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **persistent, model-editable memory/notes store** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It gives the agent a first-class way to durably write, fetch, and search "facts it wants to remember" that survive **across sessions** — something conversation-history search, `todo_write`, settings, and static skill docs do not cover.

dsh-memory README · dsh-memory：It is a community **`dsh-plugin`**: an installable Cordis bundle shipping as plain ESM JavaScript (`index.js` + `index.d.ts`), so it installs from a git host or npm with **no build step**.

Records live in one **storage domain** (`dsh_memory`) routed through the built-in `ctx.storageDomain` seam — **not** hand-rolled files — so they persist under the deployment's configured backend (json/sqlite) and emit `domain/changed` for live UIs.

dsh-memory README · Why it is not redundant：| Existing capability | Difference from dsh-memory |
|---|---|
| `session_search` / `session_event_*` | Only *read* past conversation; cannot store durable facts |
| `todo_write` | Task-status tracking, not knowledge |
| `settings` / `credentials` | Operator config, not agent-mutable knowledge |
| `skills` | Static docs; the model cannot write to them |
| `goal` / `schedule` | Objectives / reminders, not a knowledge store |
| MCP memory server | Requires an external server/account; this is a lightweight built-in |

dsh-memory README · Tools：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `memory_set` | Durably upsert a fact/note under a stable key (with optional tags). |
| `memory_get` | Read one entry by key, or list all when the key is omitted. |
| `memory_delete` | Delete an entry by key (idempotent). |
| `memory_search` | Case-insensitive substring search over key/value/tags, filterable by required tags. |

dsh-memory README · Example：```
user:  From now on, don't touch public/ in this project.
model: memory_set key="project/convention" value="Do not modify public/" tags=["project","rule"]
      → [memory] saved "project/convention" (2 tags)

dsh-memory README · Install：Install into a Harness profile. From a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-memory
```

or from this repository (no build step required — the package ships JavaScript):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Amengclass/dsh-memory
```

> The storage backend is provided by your deployment (web profiles mount `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json` with `backend: json` by default). This plugin only declares a storage **domain**, so no backend changes are needed.

dsh-memory README · Configuration：Schemastery-validated `config`, overridable from your profile patch:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `domainName` | `dsh_memory` | Name of the storage domain (must match `/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$/`). |
| `maxItems` | `1000` | Hard cap on stored entries. |
| `maxKeyLength` | `120` | Max key length; longer keys are rejected. |
| `maxValueLength` | `10000` | Max stored value length; longer values are rejected. |

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-memory
      config:
        maxItems: 500

dsh-memory README · Dependencies & license：- Runtime peer dependencies (provided by the harness's own node_modules): `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, `zod`.
- No runtime build toolchain; no Node addons.
